name: Intent Driven Selection
summary: Finger-based selection that infers which object the user intends to grab from their hand posture as the hand approaches.
howItWorks: A tracked hand's posture and position define a volume that shrinks as the fingers close around the intended object; candidates are scored continuously from the hand's behaviour until one remains and is selected.

review.notes: Added from Weise, Zender & Lucke 2019 (Oct 2026). Attributes drafted by Claude from the survey descriptions and the original paper's abstract; not yet checked against the paper.
